description:
Session duration is nowhere in the app, though every set already carries completedAt. Derive it from the first and last set in the session rather than adding an endedAt column: no migration, and no second write path that can drift out of sync with the sets (RULES 5).

Show it in the session recap and the history list. A session with a single set has no meaningful duration, so it should read as absent rather than 0:00.
title: Show how long a workout took
